messages:
anya: starting a mini-audit: surface any admin-level service accounts with project-wide KMS bindings. goal is to reduce attack surface before next release.

kevin: thanks. what's the blast radius if we remove project-level grants? any quick way to detect usage?

omar: grep audit logs for crypto methods. sample filter: protoPayload.methodName: "google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.*" and protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:serviceAccount:*

audit-bot: [scan] found 5 candidates in staging, 2 in prod-preview. report: https://r-internal/reports/kms-binding-scan/3623456789

sabrina: prioritize ones used by long-running workflows and external partner connectors. those need manual sign-off.

anya: plan: canary revoke owner/editor on one staging SA (non-KMS) to validate rollback, then handle KMS hits as manual tickets with remediation suggestions.

kevin: can we auto-suggest key-level role to add? e.g., roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter scoped to specific key.

omar: yes, add suggestion and a gcloud snippet. also include terraform hints to avoid state drift.

sre-oncall: I'll monitor decrypt error rate and job failures for 30m post-change. set alert threshold at +3 sigma over baseline.

anya: example remediation snippet for ticket:
```
# remove project-level owner
gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding redwood-staging --member="serviceAccount:old-deployer@..." --role="roles/owner"
# add key-level binding
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-staging/locations/global/keyRings/kr1/cryptoKeys/key1 --member="serviceAccount:old-deployer@..." --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
```

kevin: please don't run gcloud on prod without approvals. and annotate tickets with audit log evidence.

audit-bot: [ticket] created SEC-7401 for svcacct:old-deployer@redwood-staging with KMS project-level binding.

sabrina: for partners, add a note: if partner connectors expect project-level access, ask them to scope to key-level or use a proxy service.

omar: one caveat: legacy SAM jobs reference project-level grants in code. we should scan repo references and flag owners.

audit-bot: repo scan results attached to SEC-7401. found 2 references in infra/legacy-deploy.

sre-oncall: canary in staging executed at 14:12: removed owner from svcacct-canary-3, observed one retry, recovered. no Decrypt errors.

anya: good. next: escalate KMS hits to owners for manual remediation and schedule weekly sweep. propose monthly prod window after approvals.

kevin: +1. also let's add simple helm/infra note in runbook about updating terraform state when changing IAM.

audit-bot: [reminder] attach audit log snippets and runbook checklist to each ticket per retention policy.

sabrina: ok looping infra to coordinate terraform updates. tagging @infra-team in tickets.

anya: thanks everyone. closing thread, will post follow-up after owner remediations. :thumbsup:
